component.name: TrinityOne Suite
component.summary: Your churches Bible, resources, messaging, groups, care and more, all in one app

description.p: TrinityOne Suite is everything a church needs to stay connected, in one desktop app. It includes a steward console for managing members, groups, rotas, events and a calendar; pastoral care with meal trains and help requests; a full Bible reader with reading plans and devotionals; a directory and children's register with safeguarding controls; and giving records for your treasurer.
It also runs your church's own relay — the small server that keeps your congregation's messages and data with the church, not a third party.
Install it, set up your church in a few minutes, and share the address with your members.
